create_gaussian_function: create a JIT-compiled Gaussian function that computes normalized Gaussian values for a tensor given mean and std
build_polynomial_envelope: build a PolynomialEnvelope module with a configurable exponent for smooth cutoff of scaled distances
create_gaussian_smearing: create a GaussianSmearing module that embeds distance values into a Gaussian basis representation
build_radial_mlp: build a RadialMLP neural network with configurable channel widths, layer normalization, and SiLU activations
test_radial_modules: test the PolynomialEnvelope, GaussianSmearing, and RadialMLP modules with sample tensor inputs
